lines.en: label day85:
scene newyumiroof1
School has ended for the day and I’m finally on my way home.
lines.zh: 一天的课结束了，我终于踏上了回家的路。

lines.en: With another seemingly endless round of standardized tests around the corner and most of the girls off studying, my counseling hours have been cut back.
lines.zh: 又一轮看似没完没了的标准化考试近在眼前，大部分女孩都跑去复习了，我的咨询时间也被削减了不少。

lines.en: So, here I am with an abundance of free time and absolutely nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: 于是，我就这么揣着大把的空闲时间，却完全不知道该拿它干什么。

lines.en: And, if today is anything like most days before it, I imagine this is the part where someone walks up to me and starts a conversation before I’m able to decide anything for myself.
lines.zh: 而且，如果今天和之前的绝大多数日子一样的话，我想接下来就是那个环节了——有人走到我面前开口搭话，抢在我自己拿定主意之前。

lines.en: scene newyumiroof2
: Hey, douche monkey.
lines.zh: : 嘿，蠢猴子。

lines.en: : Yumi, that’s not even a thing.
lines.zh: : Yumi，压根没这种说法。

lines.en: : Well, it is now.
lines.zh: : 那现在有了。

lines.en: : Great. Did you stop me just to say that?
lines.zh: : 真棒。你拦下我就为了说这个？

lines.en: scene newyumiroof3
: Well...no.
lines.zh: : 呃……不是。

lines.en: Yumi goes quiet for a moment- which is a thing I don't normally get to think.
lines.zh: Yumi 沉默了片刻——这可是我平时没机会体会的事。

lines.en: Her eyes scan the halls for several seconds before she finds it in herself to swallow her pride and open her mouth again, this time making my day even weirder than it has already become over the last ten seconds.
lines.zh: 她的眼睛在走廊里扫了几秒，才终于说服自己咽下自尊、重新开口——而这一开口，把我这十秒钟里已经够怪的一天变得还要更怪。

lines.en: : I...actually need a favor.
lines.zh: : 我……其实想请你帮个忙。

lines.en: : From me? That’s new.
lines.zh: : 找我？这倒是新鲜。

lines.en: scene newyumiroof4
: Trust me, I’m no happier about this than you are.
lines.zh: : 相信我，我可没比你高兴到哪儿去。

lines.en: : I’ve been dreading having to do this all day...but at this rate, there’s no fuckin’ way I’m going to pass even {i}half{/i} the subjects on this stupid test thing.
lines.zh: : 我一整天都在为这事犯怵……可照这样下去，这场破考试里我连{i}一半{/i}科目都不可能及格。

lines.en: : So...you want me to help you study?
lines.zh: : 所以……你想让我帮你复习？

lines.en: scene newyumiroof5
: D-Don’t say it out loud, you fucking dick! Someone might hear you!
lines.zh: : 别、别他妈的大声说出来，你这个混蛋！被人听见怎么办！

lines.en: : You’re...afraid of someone hearing that you’re going to study?
lines.zh: : 你……怕别人听到你要学习？

lines.en: : I’m afraid of someone hearing me ask you for help!
lines.zh: : 我是怕别人听到我找你帮忙！

lines.en: if yumidorm10 == True:
: I’ve told you before it’s fine to ask for help. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 我之前就说过，求助没什么大不了的。别放在心上。

lines.en: : I'm just a little surprised because this is the first time you've actually...you know, done that.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点意外，因为这是你第一次真的……你知道的，这么做。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah, now that you say that, I think this is the first time you’ve ever
lines.zh: : 是啊，被你这么一说，我想这大概是你第一次

lines.en: asked me for...well, anything."
lines.zh: 向我开口要……嗯，任何东西。」

lines.en: scene newyumiroof6
: And hopefully the last.
lines.zh: : 而且希望是最后一次。

lines.en: : This is the lowest point of my life and I’m only doing it because I have no other options.
lines.zh: : 这是我人生的最低谷，我肯这么做只是因为我没别的选择了。

lines.en: I hate to think what’s in store for Yumi’s future if coming to {i}me{/i} is her best option. I’m sure Chika would be able to help her just fine.
lines.zh: 如果找我就是她最好的选择，我真不敢想 Yumi 的未来会是什么样。{i}我{/i}相信 Chika 肯定能帮她帮得很好。

lines.en: And even though I've never really seen them speak before, I doubt Makoto would say no to someone asking for her help concerning all things education.
lines.zh: 而且虽然我从没见她们俩说过话，但我想 Makoto 也不至于拒绝一个在学业上向她求助的人。

lines.en: : I guess I'll just...go unlock the classroom then.
lines.zh: : 那我就……去把教室门打开吧。

lines.en: scene newyumiroof2
: Uhh...no. Is it cool if we go to the roof instead?
lines.zh: : 呃……不要。我们去天台行不行？

lines.en: : The roof?
lines.zh: : 天台？

lines.en: : It’s just...somebody might have left something in the classroom and if they come back for it, they might think I asked you for help or something...
lines.zh: : 只是……说不定有人在教室里落了东西，要是他们回来拿，可能会以为是我找你帮忙什么的……

lines.en: : But...you {i}did{/i} ask me for-
lines.zh: : 可是……你{i}确实{/i}是找我——

lines.en: scene newyumiroof5
: I fucking know! Stop reminding me! Now, are you going to come with me to the roof or not?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈的知道！别再提醒我了！现在，你到底要不要跟我去天台？！

lines.en: : How are we even going to get onto the roof? I don’t have a key.
lines.zh: : 我们怎么上天台啊？我又没有钥匙。

lines.en: scene newyumiroof7
: You’re the teacher and you don’t have a key? The fuck is that about?
lines.zh: : 你是老师居然没有钥匙？这他妈的算怎么回事？

lines.en: : Do they normally give every teacher a key to the roof? Because that seems like something I should have been informed of.
lines.zh: : 天台的钥匙一般每个老师都发吗？这事我好像应该被告知一声吧。

lines.en: scene newyumiroof3
: Well...whatever. I’ve got one.
lines.zh: : 哼……算了。我有。
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Because I’m a fucking delinquent, remember?
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈的是个不良少女啊，记得吗？

lines.en: : Just assume I stole it or some shit...I don’t care. Point is, I’ve got the key and I’m going to the roof, so if you want to actually do your job for once, follow me.
lines.zh: : 你就当我偷来的还是怎么的……随便你。重点是，钥匙在我手上，我要去天台，所以你要是真想做一次你该做的工作，就跟我来。

lines.en: scene newyumiroof1
Yumi angrily storms up the stairs toward the roof and leaves me in the dust.
lines.zh: Yumi 怒气冲冲地冲上通往天台的楼梯，把我甩在了身后。

lines.en: I take a quick look around to see if anyone has been watching us and, once I confirm that we’re in the clear, I follow her up...
lines.zh: 我迅速环顾四周，看看有没有人在看着我们，确认四下无人之后，才跟了上去……

lines.en: scene black
scene yumiroof1
Yumi takes a seat on a nearby bench, removing a couple of books she had tucked inside of her blazer.
lines.zh: Yumi 在附近的长椅上坐下，从西装外套里抽出几本书。

lines.en: She lays them out in front of her and takes up a slightly messy seiza position in complete disregard for her skirt as she waits for me to join.
lines.zh: 她把书摊在面前，摆出一个有点潦草的正座姿势，完全不顾自己的裙子，就这么等着我过去。

lines.en: : I’m already having regrets about this.
lines.zh: : 我已经开始后悔了。

lines.en: : I haven’t even done anything.
lines.zh: : 我可还什么都没干呢。

lines.en: scene yumiroof2
: Well, whatever. Just fucking teach me something already.
lines.zh: : 哼，算了。你他妈的快点开始教我点东西。

lines.en: : Okay...What do you need help with, exactly?
lines.zh: : 好吧……具体是哪科需要帮忙？

lines.en: : Uh...Well, what’s going to be on the test?
lines.zh: : 呃……那个，考试要考什么？

lines.en: : You don’t even know that?
lines.zh: : 你连这个都不知道？

lines.en: scene yumiroof3
: How the hell {i}would{/i} I know?! I barely even come here!
lines.zh: : 我他妈的怎么可{i}能{/i}知道？！我都不怎么来学校的！

lines.en: : Good point...
lines.zh: : 说得也是……

lines.en: : Then...I guess we can start with English?
lines.zh: : 那么……我想我们可以从英语开始？

lines.en: scene yumiroof2
: Sure. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 行吧。随便你。

lines.en: I figure I might as well coach Yumi on the one of the few subjects I’m relatively competent in.
lines.zh: 我想干脆就教 Yumi 我少数几门还算拿得出手的科目之一吧。

lines.en: It’s kind of hard when she doesn’t tell me what areas she doesn’t understand, though.
lines.zh: 不过她不肯说自己哪里不懂，这就有点难办了。

lines.en: : Why the fuck do we need to learn English anyway? I’m not going to America any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我们到底为什么要学英语啊？我短期内又不去美国。

lines.en: : I don’t think anyone is going anywhere any time soon. We’re kind of stuck here.
lines.zh: : 我觉得短期内谁也去不了哪儿。我们算是被困在这儿了。

lines.en: : Exactly. They should just take English off the fucking curriculum or whatever it’s called then.
lines.zh: : 就是啊。那他们干脆把英语从那个什么鬼课程里删掉不就完了。

lines.en: : I mean, basic English isn’t particularly hard once you get the gist of it. At least it makes a lot more sense than algebra.
lines.zh: : 我是说，基础英语只要摸到窍门其实没那么难。至少比代数好懂得多。

lines.en: scene yumiroof4
: For real, though. Like...all that shit about slopes that we had to learn a few weeks ago- the fuck even was that?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。就……几周前我们学的那堆关于斜率的狗屁玩意儿——那到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: : What do slopes have to do with me? We should be learning about, like...taxes or other useful shit that we can actually do something with.
lines.zh: : 斜率跟我有什么关系？我们应该学点……比如说税务，或者其他真正有用的东西。

lines.en: : Right. And speaking of things you can do something with...English.
lines.zh: : 没错。说到能派上用场的东西嘛……英语。

lines.en: scene yumiroof5
: Shit. Yeah. My bad.
lines.zh: : 靠。行吧。我的错。

lines.en: : Do your thing.
lines.zh: : 你开始吧。

lines.en: Instead of drawing attention to Yumi’s unexpected obedience, I decide to actually start doing the job I am paid to do.
lines.zh: 我没有去提 Yumi 这份出人意料的乖顺，而是决定开始干我拿工资该干的活。

lines.en: She sits there silently, occasionally scribbling down notes in her notebook as I touch on ideas and topics she hasn’t heard before.
lines.zh: 她安静地坐在那儿，偶尔在笔记本上潦草地记几笔，而我则讲着一些她从没听过的概念和话题。

lines.en: Her handwriting is sloppy, but it’s cute in its own way.
lines.zh: 她的字写得很乱，但却有它自己的可爱之处。

lines.en: scene yumiroof6
: Wait...So what’s with all the different ways to spell “there?” I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 等等……那「there」为什么有那么多种拼法？我不懂。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with just using the same one?
lines.zh: : 一直用同一个有什么不行的？

lines.en: : Think of it like kanji and how most of them can be read in a number of ways.
lines.zh: : 你可以把它想成汉字——大多数汉字都有好几种读法。

lines.en: : Words like “there” and “your” change completely depending on the context of the sentence they're used in.
lines.zh: : 像「there」和「your」这样的词，会随所在句子的语境而完全不同。

lines.en: : What's even weirder is that there are situations where you sort of squish two words together to make alternate forms of those words- like “they're” and “you're.”
lines.zh: : 更奇怪的是，有时候你会把两个词挤在一起，变成那些词的另一种形式——比如「they're」和「you're」。

lines.en: : I get that. But is there, like...a trick to remembering them or something?
lines.zh: : 这我懂了。可是有没有……什么记住它们的窍门之类的？

lines.en: : Uhh...probably? But not one that I know of.
lines.zh: : 呃……应该有吧？不过我不知道。

lines.en: scene yumiroof7
: What a stupid fucking language.
lines.zh: : 这门语言真是蠢透了。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s pretty ridiculous most of the time. But if you ever want to get out of here, it’s probably best to at least learn a little bit.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大多数时候是挺荒唐的。不过你要是真想离开这儿，最好至少学一点。

lines.en: scene yumiroof6
: You mean like, when they open the borders back up or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你是说，等他们重新开放边境什么的？

lines.en: : That’s right. You don’t intend to stay in Kumon-mi forever, do you?
lines.zh: : 没错。你总不打算一辈子待在 Kumon-mi 吧？

lines.en: scene yumiroof8
: Huh...That’s not really something I’ve ever thought about before.
lines.zh: : 哈……这种事我还真没想过。

lines.en: : Really? Why not?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. It just...hasn’t occurred to me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不知道。就是……没想到过吧，大概。

lines.en: scene yumiroof9
: I’ve never left this city. Don’t even know what it’s like anywhere else.
lines.zh: : 我从没离开过这座城市。连别的地方是什么样都不知道。

lines.en: : I don’t know if you come from anywhere different or...if you've ever gone anywhere else...but is it even worth it to leave?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你是不是从别的地方来的，或者……你有没有去过别的地方……不过离开真的值得吗？

lines.en: : Depends on what you’re looking for, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那大概要看你在找什么了。

lines.en: : And if we don’t know what we’re looking for? What then?
lines.zh: : 那要是不知道自己在找什么呢？那怎么办？

lines.en: scene yumiroof10
: Do we just, like...walk around and search for jobs or some shit? That sounds boring as fuck.
lines.zh: : 那我们就……到处走走、找找工作什么的？听起来无聊透顶。

lines.en: : I mean, it definitely sounds boring when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，听起来确实挺无聊的。

lines.en: To be fair, I’m on Yumi’s side here.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我站 Yumi 这边。

lines.en: Life is boring.
lines.zh: 生活就是很无聊。

lines.en: Well, old life was boring.
lines.zh: 好吧，以前的生活很无聊。

lines.en: Or at least I think it was.
lines.zh: 至少我觉得是。

lines.en: I'm sure I sound like a broken record, but I can't really remember.
lines.zh: 我知道自己听起来像个坏掉的唱片，但我真的记不清了。

lines.en: But...this life?
lines.zh: 不过……现在这辈子？

lines.en: This one seems fine.
lines.zh: 这一世看起来还不错。

lines.en: For now, at least.
lines.zh: 至少目前是这样。

lines.en: Things can go wrong at any moment, though.
lines.zh: 不过，事情随时都可能出错。

lines.en: This is something I’ve learned.
lines.zh: 这是我已经学到的一课。

lines.en: One minute, you can be on top of the world-
lines.zh: 前一分钟，你还站在世界之巅——

lines.en: Then the next, your dog gets hit by a car. Or your grandfather goes into cardiac arrest and dies on the way to the hospital.
lines.zh: 下一分钟，你的狗被车撞了。或者你祖父心脏骤停，在送医途中就死了。

lines.en: This world is filled with extremely specific yet entirely spontaneous tragedies like that.
lines.zh: 这个世界里充斥着这种极其具体、却又全然突如其来的悲剧。

lines.en: But this isn’t something I need to teach Yumi.
lines.zh: 但这不是我需要教给 Yumi 的东西。

lines.en: This is something she’ll need to learn on her own.
lines.zh: 这是她得自己去学会的东西。

lines.en: : Uhh...You okay? You’re like, starin’ through me or some shit. It’s creepy.
lines.zh: : 呃……你没事吧？你那眼神跟看穿我似的什么的。挺瘆人的。

lines.en: : I’m fine. I was just thinking about life.
lines.zh: : 我没事。只是在思考人生。

lines.en: scene yumiroof11
: Well...don’t be getting all mushy about it. It’s my fault for askin’ somethin’ like that anyway.
lines.zh: : 哼……别搞得多愁善感似的。反正问这种问题本来就是我的错。

lines.en: : I couldn’t care less about leaving this place, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我才不在乎离开这地方呢。

lines.en: : I don’t really care about anything. I just wanna eat good food, sleep late, and live forever.
lines.zh: : 我其实什么都不在乎。我就想吃点好的、睡到自然醒，然后永远活着。

lines.en: : Well, one of those is clearly not possible, but I wish you the best of luck.
lines.zh: : 嗯，其中一样显然不可能，不过我还是祝你好运。

lines.en: scene yumiroof12
: So, we done here?
lines.zh: : 那么，就这样了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. You tell me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你说呢。

lines.en: : You said you needed help with everything but we’ve really only gone over English so far.
lines.zh: : 你说你每科都需要帮忙，可我们到目前为止其实只过了英语。

lines.en: : Well, what else is on the stupid test thing? It can’t be more than like...English, Japanese, and math...right?
lines.zh: : 那那破考试还有什么？总不至于超过……英语、日语和数学吧……对吧？

lines.en: I think to myself for a moment, searching deep in the back of my mind for any information pertaining to the next round of standardized tests.
lines.zh: 我琢磨了一会儿，在脑海深处翻找着与下一轮标准化考试有关的任何信息。

lines.en: I wind up with absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 结果一无所获。

lines.en: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: 哦糟糕。

lines.en: : You don't even fucking know, do you?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的压根就不知道，对吧？

lines.en: : I don't.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: scene yumiroof13
: Isn’t this your job? How the fuck do you expect to be a teacher if you don’t even know what you’re supposed to be teaching?
lines.zh: : 这不就是你的工作吗？你连自己该教什么都不知道，还他妈的怎么当老师？

lines.en: : That’s a good question, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 这个问题问得好，Yumi。

lines.en: : I don’t have an answer for it, but it’s a good question nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 我答不上来，但这依然是个好问题。

lines.en: scene yumiroof14
: Well, what the fuck am I supposed to do if we get to a part I don’t know?! Do you have, like...an answer sheet or something I could borrow?
lines.zh: : 那要是碰到我不懂的地方，我他妈的该怎么办？！你有没有……比如说答案卷什么的能借我？

lines.en: : Hello?! Anything going on in that disturbingly smooth brain of yours?!
lines.zh: : 喂？！你那颗光滑得诡异的脑子里到底有没有在转啊？！

lines.en: : Let’s just...
lines.zh: : 我们就……

lines.en: : Let's see what else I can help you with...
lines.zh: : 我们再看看我还能帮你点什么吧……

lines.en: scene black
Yumi and I skim through a few of her books and I do my best to glaze over every subject we come across.
lines.zh: 我和 Yumi 快速翻了她几本书，我尽力把碰到的每个科目都匆匆过了一遍。

lines.en: Thankfully, Chika was kind enough to include a list of the subjects on the test in Yumi’s notebook without her knowledge- so at least we had that to go off of.
lines.zh: 幸好 Chika 好心地偷偷在 Yumi 的笔记本里夹了一张考试科目清单——至少我们还有个依据。

lines.en: It wound up getting dark not much later.
lines.zh: 没过多久天就黑了。

lines.en: I offered to walk Yumi back to the dorms but she refused.
lines.zh: 我提出送 Yumi 回宿舍，但她拒绝了。

lines.en: In the end, I walked home alone while Ami yelled at me over the phone for not informing her of how late I’d be out.
lines.zh: 最后，我一个人走回家，路上 Ami 在电话里冲我吼，怪我没告诉她我会这么晚才回去。

lines.en: So it goes, I guess.
lines.zh: 日子就是这么过的吧，大概。

lines.en: I wonder how much of today's lesson Yumi will remember?
lines.zh: 不知道今天的课 Yumi 能记住多少？

lines.en: I wonder if she really will be stuck here forever.
lines.zh: 不知道她是不是真的会永远困在这儿。

lines.en: $ yumi_love += 1
$ day85 = True
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump endofweekday
